# iscc-lib

> High-performance polyglot implementation of ISO 24138:2024 International Standard Content Code (ISCC).

iscc-lib is a Rust library implementing the ISCC standard for content identification, usable from
Rust, Python, Node.js, WebAssembly, Go, Java, Ruby, C# / .NET, C / C++, Swift, and Kotlin. It
provides the 9 gen_*_v0 functions that ISO 24138 specifies, plus the gen_sum_code_v0 convenience
(Data-Code and Instance-Code in one pass), streaming hashers, text utilities, and algorithm
primitives for generating ISCC codes from digital content.

Install: `cargo add iscc-lib` (Rust), `pip install iscc-lib` (Python), `npm install @iscc/lib` (Node.js), `npm install @iscc/wasm` (WebAssembly), `go get github.com/iscc/iscc-lib/packages/go` (Go), `gem install iscc-lib` (Ruby), `dotnet add package Iscc.Lib` (C# / .NET). Java (Maven Central `io.iscc:iscc-lib`), Kotlin (Maven Central `io.iscc:iscc-lib-kotlin`), Swift (Swift Package Manager) and C / C++ (pre-built tarballs on GitHub Releases): see [Available Bindings](https://lib.iscc.codes/index.md#available-bindings).

- [Source code](https://github.com/iscc/iscc-lib)
- [Full documentation](https://lib.iscc.codes/llms-full.txt)
